d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping will hold a historic trilateral meeting in Shenzhen, China, next week on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, the White House announced. Trump plans to push for global nuclear arms reduction—following the February expiration of the US-Russia nuclear treaty—and discuss the ongoing war in Iran, though Ukraine is said to be off the agenda and no formal agreements are expected.
